name: record_updated
description: Sent to a pupil's school e-mail address when staff change their pupil record.
subject: Your school record has been updated
body: This is to let you know that your school record was updated on {updated_date}.
If anything looks wrong, or you didn't expect this change, please speak to your form tutor or the school office.

placeholders.pupil_first_name: The pupil's preferred or first name
placeholders.pupil_name: The pupil's preferred first name and surname
placeholders.changes: A bulleted list of the parts of the record that changed (names of the parts only, not the new values)
placeholders.updated_date: The date of the change, e.g. 3 November 2026
placeholders.form_details: The pupil's form, form tutor (with e-mail) and form room as they are now, one per line
